title: I made a game entirely in Claude and it honestly blew my mind.
author: Epicloa
selftext:
Game posted for reference if anyone is curious. I think the main thing that was most interesting to me was the workflow itself, my basic approach is just giving Claude an empty folder and prompting the basic idea for the game/project and then building off of that. But learning how to run tests in ways that didn't consume much usage, even if the tests themselves ran for 12+ hours was definitely the biggest production boost. This was all made with just a Pro account so definitely had to be mindful of the overall usage.

Sound was definitely the biggest struggle, eventually I figured out how to do the lo-fi loops with just Claude but that was probably the biggest hurdle in terms of play-ability/quality and I found that going for deeper/bassier defaults helped immensely. Anything treble was just infinitely unpleasant.

If anyone has any thoughts/feedback/ideas, or questions about my process or a struggle that they're having with a specific project of their own I'd love to help! Thanks for reading.

comments.author: johanlowpoly
